Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
XZ Utils is an integrated collection of user-space file compression
utilities based on the Lempel-Ziv-Markov chain algorithm (LZMA), which
performs lossless data compression. The algorithm provides a high
compression ratio while keeping the decompression time short.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the xzgrep command returned exit status 1 when contents of
one or more files did not match the requested pattern. With this update,
xzgrep returns exit status 0 if there is at least one match of the pattern,
which makes the xzgrep behavior consistent with the default grep command
behavior. (BZ#1109123)

Users of xz are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
this bug.
